$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1.

views.name: Table
views.summary: Rows under a sticky header: two group levels with fold and summaries, multi-sort, a display per column, units in the header or inline.

views.name: Pivot
views.summary: Groups x split columns, one summarised value per cell; a cell opens the records behind it.
